documents.text: Branch: Bristol Broadmead. Cust [CUSTOMER], ID seen (driving licence). Came in re app outage Fri 30/10. Pays rent (£875) to letting agent by bank transfer on the 30th every month, due date is the 30th. Tried app from approx 8am, error 'something went wrong', tried online banking on a laptop at lunch, same. Rang the phone line, held 40+ mins & gave up (on her lunch break, works in a nursery so can't have phone on her in the afternoon). Paid it Sat morning 31/10. Letting agent (Ashdown Property Lettings, contact [PERSON]) charged a £25 late payment fee under the tenancy agreement - cust showed me the email on her phone, fee dated 31/10. Cust wants the £25 back and 'an acknowledgement that it was your fault not mine'. Says she has never been late with rent & is worried about her reference with the agent. Vuln check done - none identified, cust confident with the app normally. Explained outage was bank-wide & complaint will be logged, complaints team will contact her within 3 working days and may be able to resolve then. Cust prefers text/email, mob [CUSTOMER_PHONE] confirmed. [CUSTOMER] was very polite but frustrated. - [STAFF]

Digital session log CA [ACCOUNT]. 30/10/2026 08:03 APP LOGIN FAIL ERR-503. 30/10/2026 08:04 APP LOGIN FAIL ERR-503. 30/10/2026 12:47 OLB LOGIN FAIL ERR-503. 30/10/2026 12:49 OLB LOGIN FAIL ERR-503. Linked incident INC-2026-1030-01 'app and online banking unavailable 30/10/2026 07:10-15:40'. 31/10/2026 09:12 APP LOGIN OK. 31/10/2026 09:15 Faster Payment out GBP 875.00 payee ASHDOWN PROPERTY LETTINGS ref '[CUSTOMER] WREN CT RENT'.

Complaint logged from branch ([STAFF], Broadmead). Cause: app/online banking outage. Root cause tag: INC-2026-1030-01. Amount claimed GBP 25.00 (third-party late payment fee). Customer contact pref: text/email.
